goal: Quantify the active Gear Release to CatalogRevision mapping, community and personal gear-template exactness, 40-specialization browse truth, resource baselines, and legacy callers without changing runtime data, APIs, builders, manifests, pointers, timers, or SimC tasks.
userValue: The equipment simulator migration will start from measured current truth instead of introducing a new schema around unknown data loss, hidden callers, or unsafe resource assumptions.
nonGoals: No CatalogRevision, ItemDefinition, BrowseVariant, ExactItemInstance, ResolvedLoadout, or SimulationSnapshot schema
No active Gear or Community Release build, seal, promotion, rollback, or Manifest pointer change
No community or personal template migration and no stat snapshot or historical SimC task rewrite
No public API, Taro, health/admin endpoint, timer, backfill, synchronization, deployment, or service restart
No full builder or unbounded resource characterization run

mustChange: Add pure deterministic audit classifications and an aggregate report identity.
Add a fixed-query PostgreSQL projection that uses explicit read-only transactions, bounded batches, timeouts, rollback, and zero writes.
Inventory tracked catalog, release, profile, and SimC callers without persisting matched source text.
Record aggregate-only active-release mapping, template exactness, 40-specialization browse status, relation and filesystem resource facts, and explicit unknown measurements.
Produce a mechanical Phase 1 decision that allows contracts-only, dormant schema shadow, or no next plan.
mustNotChange: Active Gear and Community Releases, Manifest pointer generation, release events, template rows, stat jobs, SimC tasks, timers, and backflow
Canonical Gear Resolver, release policy, account template authorization, SimC profile ownership, and task result access control
Public API payloads, active Taro routes, visual targets, WeChat package, and historical task interpretation
riskUnknown: The lossless mapping rate from the active Gear Release to the first CatalogRevision is not yet measured.
The Exact Item identity completeness of active community and personal gear templates is not yet measured.
Current relation and materialization sizes are measurable, but historical peak RSS and temporary bytes may remain unknown without an unsafe builder rerun.
Static callers can be enumerated from tracked source, while unresolved dynamic or runtime callers must remain partial or blocked.
evidenceRequired: TDD proof for deterministic report identity, fail-closed mapping, template exactness, 40-specialization coverage, explicit unknown resources, bounded samples, and redaction
Fixed-query store proof for read-only transactions, statement and lock timeouts, stable pointer checks, rollback, bounded rows, zero commits, and zero write statements
Deterministic tracked-file caller inventory with active backend, Taro, compatibility, test/docs, and unresolved categories
Aggregate read-only runtime audit with pointer before and after equality, zero writes, literal health state, and no created release event, template row, stat job, or SimC task
Phase 1 decision gates plus exact-head Harness verification and local CR

ownership.factOwner: server/gear_catalog_migration_audit.py owns Phase 0 classification, aggregation, status, and report identity; server/gear_catalog_audit_store.py is a read-only projection owner; scripts orchestrate explicit audits without runtime authority.

engineeringHealth.reason: The slice reads release, community, personal-template and PostgreSQL size facts across existing owners. It remains non-runtime and is constrained by fixed queries, read-only transactions, timeouts, bounded batches, aggregate-only output, deterministic identities, and zero-write verification.

acceptanceEvidence: Focused Python and Node red-green tests for every new owner and CLI boundary
Existing release-store, personal-store, project-state and Harness regression tests
Read-only production audit with unchanged pointer identity and literal partial or blocked state
Task-scoped Harness packet on the exact final verification HEAD

decisionLog.decision: The user approved the CatalogRevision plus ExactItemInstance target architecture while retaining the current equipment editor, template save, and separate SimC execution entry.
The user approved starting implementation and explicitly required focus on the main task.
Phase 0 is restricted to measured read-only inventory. Schema, builder, migration, deployment, public-reader, and pointer work require a later plan selected by the Phase 1 decision gate.
